plugins.name: borch
plugins.description: When a task wants PyTorch's API in a browser, in Pyodide/JupyterLite, on WebGPU, or where torch cannot be installed: which of borch's three entry points to use, the rules that save a rewrite, and tested recipes for training, ONNX export and a notebook cell.
